finding.summary: No test covers a cell that carries non-border style when a border preset is applied/cleared
finding.evidence: `applyBorderPatch` (sheet.ts:4009-4020) merges the patch into the existing `cell.s` and then deletes only the patched keys, i.e. it is specifically responsible for PRESERVING unrelated style keys (`b`, `al`, `bg`, ...) across a border apply/clear. Every new and updated test in the diff starts from a cell with either no style at all (lines 272-342, 361-367) or with only a value (`{ v: 'Label' }`, lines 344-359), so no assertion would fail if the merge dropped or clobbered an existing non-border style. A test like `setStyle({b:true})` -> `setRangeBorders('all')` -> `setRangeBorders('clear')` expecting `{b:true}` to survive is absent.

verdict.reason: applyBorderPatch (sheet.ts:3993-4035) merges the border patch into cell.s and deletes only the patched border keys, making preservation of unrelated style keys an explicit invariant of the new code (also stated in the task doc at docs/tasks/active/20260822-sheets-clear-borders-prune-todo.md:32-35). No test seeds a non-border style key on the target cell before a border apply/clear: formatting.test.ts:272-342, 361-367 and 390-492 start from unstyled cells, 344-359 from a value-only cell ({v:'Label'}), and 369-378 seeds only a column-level *border* key (bt). A regression that clobbered b/bg/al/nf during the merge would fail no assertion. I searched wider than the reviewer: repo-wide grep for bt:/bl:/br:/bb: finds them in only one test file (formatting.test.ts); all 60+ packages/sheets/test files were enumerated and the only other border-related tests are coordinates.test.ts (toBorderRanges geometry) and xlsx-styles.test.ts (import path); applyBorderPatch is private with setRangeBorders as its sole caller, and setRangeBorders appears outside tests only in view/spreadsheet.ts and frontend toolbars with no test coverage (frontend border hits are slides shape/table pickers; the visual harness format-scenarios.tsx:249-289 uses addRangeStyle, not the preset path, and asserts nothing about preservation). No e2e directory exists. Under the test-adequacy rubric this is a documented new behavior with no meaningful test, i.e. blocking-major.
